note: THE TOOL REGISTRY — shaped ask → the exact command that does it. Created 2026-07-28 after a flagrant tesseract miss: six commits touched a blog post and only one drift panel existed, because NOTHING in the 190-rule reef named scripts/pmu/post-drift-history.sh. The one rule in the area was DIAGNOSTIC ('panel wrong/missing → check the index FIRST'), which only helps once you already suspect breakage. Repo-wide the reef measured 5 procedural rules against 14 diagnostic: it knew post-mortems, not process. A rule tells you what is true; a TOOL tells you what to run. The lens now injects both.
contract: Each entry: when[] = shape phrases matched against the prompt (stemmed overlap, same scorer the rules use); run = the literal command; why = one line on what it produces; after[] = optional follow-ups that must run with it. Matching is deterministic and LLM-free.

tools.why: renders one tolerance panel PER COMMIT that touched the post and rewrites manifest.json — the post's edit provenance. EVERY commit touching a post needs this; the strip under-reports otherwise.
sets frontmatter image: to the densest commit panel and chains the ghost-read grade. Queues an LLM call — skip it under .thetacog/llm-pause and render panels directly instead.
the two gates a post must pass: forbidden chars + canonical spine + component registration (Check 15), then the market-meal structure.

tools.run: compose in docs/comms/<channel>/approved/<stem>.md + <stem>.grade.json, then: COMMS_DISPATCH_LIVE=1 bash scripts/comms/comms-dispatch.sh <sha>
tools.why: the folder IS the trigger. Pre-commit blocks without a grade receipt >=95 on every need; dispatch is silent unless run directly with the LIVE flag.
converts markdown to the HTML Vercel actually serves, and mints the #heading-slug anchors blog deep links depend on. A book commit without it ships a stale page.

tools.run: bash scripts/mirror-to-public.sh   # inspect, then re-run with --push
tools.why: syncs packages/thetacog-mcp to the public repo with the denylist scrub and a hard clean-assert that ABORTS on any private marker.
seats a child shelf so the topology catches the prompt next time; never mutates the parent vocabulary. Receipt appends to data/pmu/knock-on-convergence.ndjson and logs the amputation command.
